 - Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle https://sierra.ai/blog/agent-development-life-cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

 - Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups in Silicon Valley, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

 - Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.


EXAMPLE PROJECTS

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

 - Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

 - Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalizing product recommendations

 - Create generalizable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog https://sierra.ai/blog/five-ways-to-use-ai-agents-financial-services!

 - Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

 - Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

 - Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

 - A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

 - Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems

 - Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

 - Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

 - Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

 - Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

 - Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

 - Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

 - Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

 - Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

 - Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/ who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.


ABOUT THE TRAVEL, TRANSPORTATION AND HOSPITALITY TEAM

 - The Travel, Transportation and Hospitality (TTH) supports some of the largest airlines, hotel chains, rental car brands, cruise lines and travel tech companies in the world. Our customers are frontiers in the travel space, and are true thought partners in shaping our platform, helping reinvent what hospitality looks like in this new era. Our customers rely on us to not only deliver standout customer experiences, driving stronger growth in their business. 

 - Our TTH team is constantly pushing the bounds of what is possible within this industry and beyond. We help support our customers in the moments that matter — whether that’s proactively encouraging new bookings to prepare for exciting events, or helping guests rebook their flights or stays during times of distress. We help our customers maximize the lifetime value of their guests and build products to delight guests at every touchpoint.

 - We’re a small and scrappy team, and we support each other with any deliverables we have to meet. Every engineer on TTH is also a product-led thinker; every PM on TTH is tinkering and developing tangible prototypes; and every strategist on TTH is capable of owning an agent end to end. As a part of this team, you’ll set the standard on what it means to go beyond your role, and help build the travel industry of the future.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and deliver production-grade AI agents https://sierra.ai/blog/meet-the-ai-agent-engineer: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

 - Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle https://sierra.ai/blog/agent-development-life-cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

 - Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups in Silicon Valley, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

 - Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.


EXAMPLE PROJECTS

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

 - Building innovative multimodal experiences: Spearhead cross-cutting initiatives, partnering with the voice and Experience SDK teams to bring to life embedded voice mode in mobile apps. This brand new product allows users to talk, tap and text with our agents all in a single view — unlocking communication through rich visualizations, and accuracy in input collection with chat, with the ease and efficiency of voice.

 - Shipping complex booking experiences: Build personalized booking flows, including leveraging Google Maps APIs to support searching for properties via an embedded map view, developing a recommendation engine based on past reservations and orchestrating seamless payment collection to complete the full booking lifecycle.

 - Abstracting complex systems into packages: Modernize legacy reservations systems by creating Sierra packages that optimize querying and updating trips for customers across the board. You’ll be challenged to think deeply about how to orchestrate each step of these workflows to maximize efficiency while upholding reliability and accuracy.

 - Improving the capabilities of our built in integrations: Expand platform extensibility by introducing new capabilities to our existing integrations. An example is extending our MCP integrations to support MCP UI, which allows customers to dynamically host their custom UI resources on our embedded chat windows.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems.

 - Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.

 - A builder and tinkerer's mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship.

 - Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems.

 - Excellent communication skills—clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Excitement in the travel space and a genuine care for helping improve the guest experience as a whole. Our customers care deeply about their guests, and we carry that through what we build every day.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Language Fluency: Professional fluency in both Spanish and English.

 - Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

 - Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

 - Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

 - Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

 - Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

 - Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

 - Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

 - Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. About Snorkel
Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.
Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!
The Role
As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll research and utilize state-of-the-art Gen AI and machine learning (ML) techniques to successfully deliver solutions to our customers. You will work directly with our customers to understand their business and technical needs and design and deliver AI solutions to solve them. You will also help define Snorkel’s Applied AI tooling by translating repeatable real-world challenges into reusable solution recipes, workflows, best practices, and platform-level capabilities that become part of Snorkel’s next generation of AI tooling. We move fast and are constantly prototyping and innovating new ways to deliver value to our customers. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, bridging the gap between AI technology and business value, working directly with customers, keeping up-to date with AI research, and standardizing bespoke solutions into internal recipes and staying naturally curious about the infrastructure that underpin the Applied AI stack end-to-end.
Main Responsibilities
Partner with customers to build and deploy impactful Gen AI and machine learning solutions, from use case scoping and data exploration to model development and deployment. This will involve designing custom approaches using state-of-the-art tools, with the goal of delivering real business value and informing the evolution of Snorkel’s tooling.

About Snorkel
Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.
Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!
About the Role
Snorkel AI is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on Computer Use Agents to partner with leading AI labs and enterprises on their most critical agentic-AI initiatives.
In this role, you will lead the technical execution of complex customer engagements involving agents that operate computers, browsers, and software environments to complete realistic, multi-step tasks. You will translate ambiguous product and model challenges into robust task environments, datasets, evaluators, and delivery plans that improve agent reliability and downstream performance.
You will work across the full delivery lifecycle—from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, evaluation, and production delivery. You will also identify patterns across engagements and turn successful approaches into reusable capabilities, technical standards, and product improvements.
Main Responsibilities
Computer Use Agents, Data, and Evaluation

Develop data-generation, validation, and quality-assurance pipelines for multimodal and agentic training and evaluation data
Build automated evaluators, checks, and measurement frameworks to assess task completion, correctness, robustness, efficiency, and adherence to requirements
Diagnose agent failures across planning, tool use, perception, state management, and interaction with user interfaces; turn findings into improved tasks, data, and evaluations

Deliver reusable, production-grade task suites, datasets, and evaluation assets that help customers train, benchmark, and improve computer-use agents

Build, refine, and iterate on solutions that address customer needs, incorporating feedback to ensure the delivered work provides tangible value
Rapidly prototype and productionize solutions across models, agent frameworks, APIs, browser or desktop environments, and custom applications
Communicate technical tradeoffs, experimental results, and recommendations clearly to technical and cross-functional stakeholders
Serve as a trusted technical partner to customers and internal delivery teams, resolving complex blockers and driving alignment
Technical Leadership & Scale
Identify recurring patterns across customer engagements and turn successful solutions into reusable task frameworks, evaluators, tooling, and best practices
Define and improve technical standards for agent task design, environment reliability, evaluation, and delivery
Partner with DaaS Engineering, Research, and Product teams to influence platform and product capabilities based on real-world customer needs

Stay current with emerging agentic-AI, computer-use, evaluation, and data-curation techniques and assess their applicability to customer problems

WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.






ABOUT THE ROLE

Socure is building the future of trust for digital ecosystems. To accelerate our mission, we are expanding the platform to include agentic workflows and internal productivity tools that power innovation across the company. These systems will underpin how Socure builds, deploys, and scales AI-driven identity solutions while enabling internal teams to operate with speed, intelligence, and precision.

Reporting to the Head of New Product Engineering, you'll join a new Internal AI Engineering team with a mandate to design and ship the agentic systems that reshape how Socure operates across sales, marketing, revenue ops, finance, talent, and legal. As a Staff AI Engineer on this team, you'll define what to build - not just execute what's been scoped. You'll be the first major internal partner building on Socure's Agentic AI Foundations platform - using its primitives to ship faster and providing the real-world pull-through that shapes its roadmap. By delivering intelligent automation and agentic workflows you will play a central role in Socure's transformation into an AI-native company, driving step-function gains in efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making across the enterprise.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Prioritization of High-Impact Automation - Partner with business teams (e.g., Revenue Ops, Marketing, Finance Ops, Talent Acquisition) to catalog manual, high-frequency workflows and rank them by impact, feasibility, and urgency.

 - Production Agent Design & Development - Build multi-step, tool-augmented agent workflows that can plan, execute, observe outcomes, and iteratively improve. Design and implement planner–executor and reflection-based architectures to enhance reasoning quality and task reliability. Develop stateful agent systems and incorporate human-in-the-loop controls, including approval gates, fallback paths, and escalation mechanisms.

 - Platform Integration - Leverage the Agentic AI Foundations team's platform covering agent runtime, orchestration, memory, tool registry, guardrails, and observability. Provide feedback that shapes platform priorities.

 - Innovation & Standards - Leverage LLMs, multi-agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms to create differentiated internal solutions that can't be bought off the shelf. Stay ahead of emerging AI technologies and regulatory frameworks to ensure Socure leads the industry in secure, compliant, and intelligent internal systems.

 - Technical Patterns - Discover reusable agent design patterns while building real workflows and contribute them back to the Agentic AI Foundations paved paths so the work compounds across Socure.

 - Operational Excellence - Leverage the evaluation harness and tracing substrate provided by Agentic AI Foundations for continuous performance assessment, failure-mode analysis, and optimization of speed and accuracy of specific agentic solutions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


REQUIRED

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems or LLM-powered applications in production.

 - Deep hands-on experience with LLM APIs and at least one agentic framework (e.g. LangGraph, CrewAI or AutoGen).

 - Strong Python skills and experience building production-grade backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.

 - Proven ability to operate in ambiguity: you've walked into an undefined problem space, figured out what to build, built it, and measured the results.

 - Experience shipping AI/automation solutions that directly impacted business operations.

 - Strong systems thinking: you design for reliability, observability, and maintainability from day one, not as an afterthought.

 - Ability to collaborate directly with non-technical business stakeholders to understand their actual workflows and translate those into technical solutions.


PREFERRED

 - Experience with multi-agent systems, workflow orchestration, or complex tool-use patterns in production.

 - Familiarity with evaluation frameworks (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, Arize, or custom eval pipelines) for AI systems (agent reliability, accuracy benchmarking, failure-mode analysis).

 - Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, or memory/grounding systems.

 - Experience with real-time or streaming AI systems.

 - Familiarity with AI safety and security practices, including prompt injection prevention, hallucinations mitigation and data protection/privacy.

 - Background in a regulated industry (fintech, healthcare, government) where compliance and security review processes are standard.

 - Experience with agent skill abstraction and structured tool integration via MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling or similar protocols.

 - Experience with AWS-hosted LLM infrastructure (Bedrock, AgentCore/Strands, Lambda, SageMaker) or equivalent cloud ML services.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with comfort working alongside cross-functional partners such as product, data science, platform, and security.

 - Experience with multi-agent systems, workflow orchestration, or distributed coordination frameworks through professional work, research, coursework, or technical projects.

 - Experience building or using agent platforms — such as orchestration frameworks, tool registries, or memory systems — or LLM routing, caching, or fine-tuning pipelines through professional work, research, internships, open-source contributions, or personal projects.

ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno's song creation agent takes a plain-language request, plans the steps, and calls our music models and audio tools to make the song. We're hiring Senior / Staff Full-Stack / AI Engineers to build the backend, data and evals behind it, working alongside ML engineers, PMs and the product teams who build on top of it. Most of the work is making a nondeterministic system behave, and proving that it does before anything ships. You'll join a small team and own your part of the agent, with a real say in how the rest of it is built.
Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/YIofhzxQWKjXfwPS




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and run the backend for an AI agent that plans multi-step requests and calls music models and audio tools.

 - Design the evals, datasets and release gates that decide whether a change to the agent ships, and make the call when the results are noisy.

 - Develop the data pipelines that feed the agent and its evals, working alongside ML engineers.

 - Create internal tools for running and reviewing evals.

 - Share on-call and launch support for a high-traffic production system, and help the team ramp new engineers as it grows.

 - Help make creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by shipping the features people use to turn an idea into music.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED



MUST-HAVES

 - 4–6 years building and scaling general backend systems in production, in any language: services at scale, observability and on-call ownership.

 - Experience shipping and operating an LLM-powered agent or feature in production, for external or internal users, with multi-step tool calling.

 - Experience building evals for nondeterministic systems, such as regression sets, graders or LLM judges, and using the results to decide what ships.

 - Comfort on a small team that runs production: handling ambiguity, unblocking yourself, and working with ML engineers, PMs and partner teams.
   


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with Python backends.

 - Experience building internal tools or dashboards, in TypeScript and React, for reviewing model output.

 - Experience with audio, music or other media generation systems.

 - Experience with LLM tracing and observability tools.
   


WORK LOCATION POLICY

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno SF office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.



ADDITIONAL NOTES

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.



PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)




COMPENSATION

 - $228K- $363K



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a82f5c168c.description:
协助全球各工厂信息安全体系日常运营与管理工作
1、负责运维信息安全设备、系统，监视全网安全状况，记录并上报异常事件；
2、落实服务器、网络设备及应用系统的安全方案，落实公司的应用安全、网络安全、系统安全、终端安全和数据安全等信息安全的策略和流程；定期核查落实情况；
3、实施信息安全防护整体技术规划和计划，主导并推动信息安全建设项目，落实系统抗攻击防泄漏等安全措施，寻找安全技术缺陷并制定改进方案；
4、监测公司信息安全管理水平和安全隐患，实施相应应急预案并定期演练，积极预防及汇报信息安全事件，定期编制安全分析报告；
5、关注业内安全事件及安全动态，跟踪最新漏洞信息，进行安全渗透攻击分析与还原、研究、编写分析报告；
6、开展员工信息安全意识及安全技术的培训工作，协助开展信息安全审计工作，整理安全合规文档及风险评估材料；
7、跟踪大模型（LLM）、智能体（AI Agent）等AI应用的安全动态，了解提示词注入（Prompt Injection）、数据与模型投毒（Data/Model Poisoning）、敏感信息泄露、模型越狱等OWASP LLM Top 10常见风险，参与AI系统安全隐患的识别与记录工作；
8、了解AI技术在安全运营中的应用场景（如AI辅助告警分析、自动化威胁检测等），在指导下尝试使用AI工具提升安全运维效率。
collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a82f5c168c.requirements:
1、统招本科及以上学历，计算机网络、信息安全相关专业或相关企业经验优先；
2、熟悉信息安全理论；熟悉信息安全相关风险点；
3、了解网络运行原理，对路由器、防火墙、IDS/IPS/WAF等设备有基本认知；
4、了解Windows、Linux等环境下的管理工具、服务和安全防护，能使用Windows/Linux基本命令行操作；
5、了解大语言模型（LLM）、RAG、AI Agent等AI技术的基本原理，对OWASP LLM Top 10、MITRE ATLAS等AI安全风险框架有基本认知；
6、了解提示词注入、模型越狱、数据投毒等常见AI攻击手段的基本原理，对提示词注入的常见防御方法（如输入过滤、角色校验、输出审查等）有基本了解；
7、熟悉信息安全等级保护、ISO27001等信息安全体系，了解《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》、GB/T 45654-2025《生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求》及NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001等国内外AI安全治理框架，具备较强的风险评估技能；
8、有行业资格证书者优先考虑，如CCNP/HCNP、CCIE/HCIE、等级保护测评师、CISP、CISA、CISSP、Security+、CISAW、PMP、ISO 27001LA等证书
9、有使用过主流大模型服务（如文心一言、ChatGPT、DeepSeek等）或智能体开发的实践经验者优先；有AI安全相关项目经验者优先。
10、具备CET6或以上英语听说读写交流能力

collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a671af953b.ai_basis: 标题明确应用对象或部署职责
collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a671af953b.campaign: 日常招聘 社会招聘
collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a671af953b.description:
1、AI智能体应用开发，主导重点AI应用从需求分析、原型验证、方案设计到上线交付，负责核心链路、系统架构、数据流、调用链、Prompt/Agent流程、评测机制和异常处理策略设计；协调产品、业务、研发及测试资源，推动场景从0到1落地。 
2、系统集成、工程治理与安全合规，负责AI应用与现有业务系统、数据平台、权限体系、流程工具的集成设计，建立API、数据、日志、监控、性能、成本和版本管理规范；推进模型输出质量、权限隔离、数据安全、内容安全、稳定性与上线评审等治理机制。
 3、业务部门AI技术培训 ， 负责根据业务部门AI能力建设需求，制定技术培训计划与知识传递方案，开展AI工具使用、Prompt Engineering、智能体搭建等实操培训；深入业务场景进行AI应用调研与需求分析，提供技术可行性评估与方案建议；建立业务部门AI知识库与FAQ体系，持续跟踪培训效果并优化内容，推动AI技术在研发、运营、营销及管理场景的规模化落地应用。
collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a671af953b.requirements:
1、教育背景：本科及以上学历，计算机科学与技术、软件工程、人工智能、数据科学等相关专业优先。
2、经验要求：3年以上AI应用开发或相关领域工作经验；具备大模型（LLM）应用落地、智能体（Agent）开发或RAG系统建设经验者优先；有企业数字化转型或AI中台建设经验者优先。
3、专业知识：扎实的计算机科学基础，熟悉数据结构、算法设计与软件工程；深入理解机器学习、自然语言处理（NLP）及大语言模型原理；熟悉主流AI框架和工具链（如LangChain、LlamaIndex、OpenAI API等）。
4、硬技能：精通Python编程，熟悉Node.js/TypeScript等全栈开发能力者优先；熟练掌握Prompt Engineering、Agent工作流设计、知识库构建与检索增强生成（RAG）技术；具备系统架构设计能力，熟悉微服务、API网关、容器化（Docker/K8s）等技术栈；了解数据安全、权限管理与合规治理相关知识。
5、软技能：优秀的逻辑思维和问题拆解能力，能独立推动复杂项目从0到1落地；良好的跨部门沟通协调能力，能有效对齐业务、产品、研发等多方需求；具备技术分享和培训能力，能推动业务部门AI能力建设与知识传递；具备较强的学习能力和技术敏感度，能快速跟进AI领域前沿动态。
6、其他要求：对AI技术有浓厚热情和持续探索精神，具备创新意识；能承受一定工作压力，具备高度的责任心和自驱力；有良好的文档习惯和代码规范意识。

collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6af3cbf11a9.description:
这是一个聚焦 Python工程能力 与 AI服务架构落地 的初级岗位。你将参与公司核心AI应用的设计与建设，负责模型能力封装、智能体开发、服务编排等工作，在导师带领下推动AI能力从单点验证走向产品化落地。未来可向资深AI工程师、AI架构师方向发展。
1. Python后端开发：参与AI应用后端服务的设计、开发与维护，基于Python构建稳定的模型服务与智能体服务，完成模块化设计与服务联调；
2. 智能体（Agent）开发：参与面向业务场景的智能体系统开发，在多轮对话、任务拆解、状态流转、工具调用等方向上进行功能实现与优化；
3. 架构与规范沉淀：在导师指导下参与AI服务架构设计，协助完成接口规范、工程规范的整理与落地，沉淀通用组件文档；
4. 效果评测与优化：建立AI应用效果评测机制，从准确率、响应时延等维度进行持续迭代优化，学习并实践RAG、工作流编排等增强技术。
collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6af3cbf11a9.requirements:
1. 学历专业：硕士学历，计算机、人工智能等相关专业；
2. Python工程能力：熟练掌握Python编程，了解Web服务框架（如FastAPI、Flask），具备基本的接口开发与异常处理能力；
3. AI基础认知：对大模型应用的基本工程范式（Prompt、RAG、Agent、Tool Use等）有基础理解，有相关课程项目或实习经验者优先；
4. 学习与自驱力：对AI技术有强烈兴趣，具备快速学习新技术的能力，愿意深入钻研智能体、服务编排等方向；
5. 问题分析与协作：具备基本的代码调试与问题定位能力，良好的团队沟通与协作意识；
6. 加分项（非必须）
· 了解智能体核心机制（状态机、记忆机制、任务规划、多智能体协同等）；
· 接触过任意AI应用开发框架（如Dify、LangGraph、AutoGen等）；
· 了解消息队列、缓存、数据库等后端基础组件；
· 有大模型API调用经验或个人AI项目/比赛经历；
· 有技术文档撰写或团队分享经验。

collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a82f63668c.requirements:

2、熟练掌握Python编程语言，熟悉FastAPI、Flask等后端框架，具备异步编程（asyncio）及RESTful API开发能力；

7、熟悉Docker容器化技术，具备基本的Linux操作系统使用能力，能够完成应用的部署、运行维护及基础问题排查；
8、具备良好的团队协作与沟通能力，积极主动，具有较强的学习能力、问题分析能力和环境适应能力；

2、使用Docker等容器化技术，完成AI平台的开发、测试、部署及日常运维工作；
3、理解主流大模型及开源框架的基本技术原理，结合业务场景，为高效、低成本的技术选型提供建议；
4、跟踪AI领域（大模型、生成式AI、多模态等）的前沿技术动态，结合公司业务场景探索创新应用方向，参与编制技术可行性分析报告；
5、熟悉使用AI开发者平台开展智能体开发、流程自动化及系统集成，参与优化模型推理效率与资源消耗，支持业务场景快速迭代；
6、支持各业务领域AI应用的工程化落地，协助设计并实现安全、高可靠、高性能、可扩展的AI应用，满足业务需求。

1、本科及以上学历，人工智能、软件工程、计算机科学与技术等相关专业，有相关实习或项目经验者优先；
2、熟练掌握Python编程语言，熟悉FastAPI、Flask等后端框架，具备异步编程（asyncio）及RESTful API开发能力；
3、熟悉React、Next.js等前端开发框架，了解React Hooks、状态管理及TypeScript类型系统等前端技术；
4、熟悉TensorFlow、PyTorch等主流深度学习框架，了解分布式系统的基本原理或具备相关开发经验；
5、熟悉Dify、n8n等开源平台或框架的开发流程，包括智能体开发、流程自动化、API调用及系统集成；
6、熟悉PostgreSQL、MySQL等SQL数据库及SQLAlchemy等ORM工具，能够支持平台数据的存储与管理；
7、熟悉Docker容器化技术，具备基本的Linux操作系统使用能力，能够完成应用的部署、运行维护及基础问题排查；
8、具备良好的团队协作与沟通能力，积极主动，具有较强的学习能力、问题分析能力和环境适应能力；
9、具有大模型应用工程、智能体开发或RAG（检索增强生成）相关实习、项目开发及方案设计经验者优先。

collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6ac9cf1b15a.description:
1、架构设计与规划：
①设计端到端AI系统架构（包括数据管道、模型训练、部署监控、服务化等环节）。
②制定AI技术路线图，评估并引入适合的AI框架（如TensorFlow、PyTorch）、云平台（AWS/Azure/GCP）及工具链。
③设计高并发、低延迟的AI服务架构（如微服务、Serverless）。
2、技术方案落地：
①主导大型AI项目（如推荐系统、NLP平台、计算机视觉系统）的技术方案设计与实施。
②优化模型训练与推理性能（分布式训练、模型压缩、硬件加速等）。
③构建自动化MLOps流水线，实现模型持续集成与部署（CI/CD）。
3、技术研究与创新：
①跟踪AI领域前沿技术（如大模型、AutoML、联邦学习），评估其落地可行性。
②制定AI治理规范（模型可解释性、数据隐私、伦理合规）；主导技术难题攻关与专利输出。
4、系统可靠性保障：
①设计高可用、容灾备份的AI基础设施架构。
②建立监控告警体系，保障AI服务的SLA（99.9%+可用性）。
制定安全策略，防御对抗攻击、数据泄露等风险

1、本科以上学历，计算机相关专业
2、①10年以上软件开发经验和3年以上架构工作经验，2年以上AI相关工作经验，具备类似coze、dify等AI平台建设经验（必备）
②具备丰富的多层架构体系开发经验，有大型分布式、高并发、高负载、高可用性系统设计和开发经验。百万级用户量项目经验优先考虑
3、能力要求：
①精通Python，熟悉Java/Scala/C++中的至少一种。
②深入理解机器学习/深度学习算法（CNN/RNN/Transformer等）及框架（PyTorch/TensorFlow）。
③熟悉云原生技术栈（Kubernetes、Docker、服务网格）。
④掌握大数据生态（Spark/Flink/Kafka）及数据库技术（SQL/NoSQL/向量数据库）。
